rubric.PASS: Every turn executed through actual local auth and route, no blocked provider-dependent response; all frozen checks pass; open-ended content additionally reviewed by the operator.
rubric.FAIL: Executed deterministic or real-provider behavior violates expected outcomes.
rubric.UNTESTED: Not run, transport unavailable, inference blocked or ambiguous semantic review.
rubric.exact_body: Extract the sole fenced body if present; otherwise trim only the whole response; compare complete body byte-for-byte to independently literal-substituted approved source.
rubric.critical: Any confirmed unauthorized protected body/source/payload or exposed credential stops testing immediately.
rubric.accuracy: PASS/(PASS+FAIL); always show all 30 cases and UNTESTED separately.
